prompts.center: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Input1 is the owner's PREFERRED traversal design and is the GEOMETRY/STYLE AUTHORITY. Input2 is the original campus collage supplying identifying pale bluegreen rust-streaked RIVETED steel, concrete and moss; DO NOT copy its photographic perspective. Recreate one CENTER 3:1 full-canvas transparent scene plate at target2160x720, keeping input1's substantial orthogonal labyrinth almost exactly: thick pale-bluegreen rusty steel girder side faces, concrete supports, connected broad platforms, tall vertical shafts, ladders inside shafts, many up/down/right-angle branches, loops and dead ends. The maze fills the full HEIGHT and WIDTH like input1, NOT small thin orange pipes squeezed under one giant horizontal bridge. Tall vertical range and graph/pathfinding-like complex silhouettes are crucial. Flat 2D SIDE ELEVATION, no vanishing point. Source1 layout already composes the whole layer. Keep its muted green grey orange material palette, sparse ivy and walkway guardrails, open gaps. Clean the red/green extraction fringe, recover hidden girder ends and ladder rungs, make openings genuinely transparent. Preserve scene positions, don't crop tightly/recenter. NO sky, far trees, water, giant roof bridge, characters, words, arrows, grids, HUD or glitch. True RGBA alpha, full 3:1 canvas. Both edges remain open for neighboring extensions of this traversal network; retain source1's low left entry and right edge's multiple clipped branches. Output ONLY the substantial maze/traversal layer, not backdrop or collage. Do not simplify the reference into narrow bars.
prompts.left: Use case: stylized-concept/background-extraction. Input1 is the preferred CENTER traversal layer of a side-scrolling game. Generate the neighboring LEFT panel of the SAME labyrinth on TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, target2160x720 3:1. Output ONLY the NEW extension, no triptych. Design authority: this is a massive complex PATHFINDING-LIKE architectural maze, thick PALE BLUE-GREEN riveted steel girders, rust-orange stains, thick concrete shafts/piers, broad horizontal shelves/platforms, short and tall ladders INSIDE shafts, many right-angle turns, loops, dead ends and up-down routes. It fills the FULL HEIGHT/WIDTH with open traversable gaps and sparse hanging ivy/guardrails, NOT little orange pipes under one straight bridge. Strict FLAT SIDE ELEVATION with all long girders horizontal and supports vertical; no perspective or converging lines. Match pixel clusters, material scale, colors and side-face girder thickness exactly. Your RIGHT edge must approach source1 LEFT boundary's low concrete entry at about y420-600; grow a richer upper/lower branching maze on the left while giving one branch into that low right entry. Edges can clip continuing branches. Keep meaningful empty shafts/openings rather than one solid mass. No sky, far trees, water, huge roof bridge, ground backdrop, white/black/checkerboard fill, text, character, icons, HUD or corruption. All outside maze geometry is alpha. Extrapolate structure where needed; no opaque matte, no bright extraction fringe. Reference is original generated art, not borrowed commercial assets.

prompts.location--left--center: Repair one actual join of the clean creek-location banner, including water reflection color layer in a flat side-scrolling pixel-art stage. Image 1 is the exact staggered context canvas, not a style reference. The seam lies at x=1080. Change only the band x=[824,1336); image 2 shows the edit mask (transparent means editable). Continue existing silhouettes, steel edges, foliage, waterlines or reflections as appropriate; connect matching platform ends without deleting branches or inventing a new camera. Keep every pixel outside the band, original scale, palette and flat projection. Transparent holes stay transparent; no matte, labels, HUD, glow or new scenery layer. Output the complete 2160x720 context canvas, not a tight crop. Match girder/rail/waterline heights and bridge tree/cloud texture discontinuities. This clean location is a separate source study, not a backdrop pre-approved to combine with the substantial maze. The damaged join in this actual canvas is at its center. Smooth that single join inside the mask; do not create an unrelated replacement scene. For alpha layers, preserve clear openings. The supplied mask is opaque white outside the middle edit band and transparent inside. Output the whole context at2160x720.
